title: NIH Notification 2026 - Walk-in-Interview for Project Scientist I Posts
description: National Institute of Hydrology (NIH Roorkee) has declared the official notification for 2026. To fill the vacancies for various Project Scientist I Jobs. Candidates who have qualified for a Ph.D, M.E/ M.Tech in Civil Engineering can grab this chance and apply for the NIH Notification 2026 . Here we have included the age limit, selection process, salary structure, education details, applciation fee, and how to apply for these posts. Interested and eligible candidates can apply before the last...
